The issuer exhibits strong profitability with an operating margin of ~20.2% and a solid equity base, but its financial flexibility is constrained by high leverage (Total Liabilities / Total Assets of 65.9%) and a weak liquidity profile evidenced by a current ratio of 0.72x. Additionally, asset efficiency is relatively low (Asset Turnover of 0.19x), which is typical for capital-intensive industries or financial/holding entities. Balancing the solid earnings capacity and substantial net worth against the elevated leverage and working capital deficit places the company comfortably in the solid investment-grade tier.

DECISION: BBB
